（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 10
Date 10 - 1 - 16

10th January 1916

Sir,
The sale of Shenpao 申報 was prohibited in the
French Concession on the 6th and 7th instants owing to
its having published translations from a German newspaper
adversely criticising French methods in the conduct of
the war. The sale of S Pao 時報 was also forbidden
for the same reason. Both papers having published
corrections are now being sold as usual.
Having heard a report that Yuan Shih Kai has
consented to concede Woosung to the Japanese in return
for recognition of the Monarchy, the Chapei gentry held
a secret meeting yesterday, when it was decided to send
a code telegram to Yuan requesting him not to grant
the concession, even though such action oblige him
to abandon the monarchical programme.
Tsu Tuh Eu 周德厚 who some three weeks ago was
reported to have arrived in Shanghai from Japan and was
later reported to have gone to Nanking to induce
General Feng Kuo Chang 國璋 to declare for the Republic
is now reported to be in Nagasaki. It is said that
his wife had received a letter from him from that place
in which he states that he was favourably received by
General Feng, who would openly join the republicans
in the near future.
It is reported that the manager of the Bank of
Communications was shot by the rebels because he sent
a telegram to the manager of the head branch of the
Bank in Yunnan instructing him to burn all the bank notes
in his possession. Another report says that on 5th instant
deceased promised the anti-monarchical party $100,000.00
and he was shot because he failed to keep his promise.
It is reported that the attempt to blow up the
railway line is the work of rebels who had heard that
Deputy Military Governor Lu intended to go to Nanking
by the train which left Shanghai at 11 p.m. on the
night in question.

Your Obedient Servant,
Mummuthal
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（批：Endorsed on list
Jan. 10.
Seen by C.I.D.）

警务处，
（侦探科）

刑事侦缉处
情报官登记
第 10 号
日期 16-1-10

1916年1月10日

先生：

由于《申报》刊登了译自一家德国报纸的文章，对法国在战争中的做法进行不利批评，法租界于本月6日和7日禁止销售该报。《时报》也因同样原因被禁售。两家报纸均刊登了更正声明，目前已恢复照常销售。

据悉袁世凯已同意以承认帝制为交换条件，将吴淞让予日本人，闸北士绅昨日举行秘密会议，决定发送密电给袁世凯，请求其不要出让该地，即便此举迫使他放弃帝制计划。

周德厚 (Tsu Tuh Eu) 约三周前据报从日本抵达上海，后又据报前往南京游说冯国璋将军 (General Feng Kuo Chang) 宣布拥护共和，现据报他在长崎。据说他的妻子收到他从该地寄来的信，信中称他受到冯将军的礼遇，冯将在不久的将来公开加入共和派。

据报交通银行经理被叛乱分子枪杀，原因是他向云南总行经理发出电报，指示其烧毁所持有的所有钞票。另一则消息称，死者于本月5日曾许诺反帝制派十万美元，因未兑现承诺而被枪杀。

据报炸毁铁路线的企图是叛乱分子所为，他们获悉副督军卢某打算乘坐当晚11点从上海开出的火车前往南京。

您顺从的仆人，
Mummuthal
首席侦探督察

警务处巡官队长

（批注：列入清单
1月10日。
刑事侦缉处阅）
